rootCause: Darwin address-family port shadowing: Supertest implicitly binds HTTP to IPv6 wildcard but connects to IPv4 loopback. An existing IPv4 listener at the chosen port receives the request.

alternatives.productLatencyOrDeadlock: Ruled out for captured failures: intended backend never accepted the TCP connection or HTTP request; no waiting database session.
alternatives.timeoutBudget: Not causal: packets went to another process. No timeout changed.
alternatives.resourceExhaustion: Not causal for captured stall: event loop responsive; socket established to wrong process.
alternatives.socketReuse: No reused client socket in captured failing requests.
alternatives.processLeak: No stale Maya listener owns either captured destination; these are existing unrelated local services.
alternatives.orderingConcurrency: Changes probability of ephemeral port choice; not required for deterministic reduced reproduction.
alternatives.environment: Darwin wildcard/IPv4 coexistence plus occupied loopback port triggers flaw.

fix: One awaited app.listen(0, 127.0.0.1) before any request; same port until app.close; listenLoopback returns that address.
